Software Engineer

If you're reading this, you can call me Akhdan.

I'm Gaza Fathya Akhdan, a Fullstack Developer and UI/UX Designer with a passion for building clean, user-centered digital experiences.

My work spans from responsive web applications to visual design — ranging from e-commerce platforms to company profile websites and news applications.

Currently based in Bekasi, Indonesia. When I'm not coding or designing, I enjoy sharing knowledge by teaching other students across Jakarta and West Java.
